quote: We evaluate LLM performance on four auxiliary tasks: (i) labelling an answer as wrong or correct, (ii) labelling an individual reasoning step, (iii) editing an incorrect answer to make it correct, and (iv) solving a new question.
We study LLMs of different sizes: Command R (35 billion parameters), Llama 3 70B Instruct  (70 billion parameters), Command R+ 1 (104 billion parameters), Wiz-ardLM  (141 billion parameters)...
outputs: rationales justifying correctness, edited answers, solved answers with step-by-step reasoning
The outputs include step-by-step reasoning traces, final numerical answers, labels for correctness of answers or reasoning steps, and edited versions of incorrect answers.

quote: Performance in the binary labelling tasks is measured by the macroaveraged F1-score, weighted by support to account for label imbalance. Performance is measured by computing the accuracy of the numerical solution for editing and solving tasks.
